description: Uses GitHub Copilot through the official Copilot SDK, signed in with the Axiora Code GitHub app. The Copilot runtime is downloaded from GitHub on first use.
command.signIn: Sign in to GitHub for Copilot
command.useLegacyEngine: Switch to the Legacy Copilot Engine
command.useSdkEngine: Switch to the Copilot SDK Engine
config.engine: Which engine provides GitHub Copilot models in Axiora Code.
config.engine.sdk: Official GitHub Copilot SDK with the Axiora Code GitHub app (default).
config.engine.legacy: Legacy built-in Copilot engine. Copilot SDK models are hidden. Requires re-enabling the legacy engine (see README).
config.allowAgentTools: Agent mode: Copilot can list, read and search files in the open workspace folder, and can create/edit files and run commands there only after you approve each action in a dialog. Nothing outside the workspace folder is accessible, and the Copilot SDK's own built-in tools stay disabled. In untrusted workspaces only reading is allowed. / وضع الوكيل: يقرأ ملفات المشروع، ويعدّلها ويشغّل الأوامر فقط بعد موافقتك.
config.enabled: Enable GitHub Copilot (Copilot SDK) in Axiora Code. When off, Copilot models are removed from the Chat model picker and the Copilot runtime is not started. Chat, your own API keys (BYOK) and Ollama keep working.
command.downloadRuntime: Download Copilot Runtime (from GitHub) / تنزيل محرّك Copilot
command.removeRuntime: Remove Copilot Runtime / حذف محرّك Copilot
config.runtimePath: Optional path to a GitHub Copilot CLI executable you installed yourself. When empty, the official runtime is downloaded from GitHub (npm package @github/copilot-<platform>) automatically in the background on first use (only while Copilot is enabled), verified and cached in the extension's storage.
